task: create a script that displays a random motivational quote with ASCII art border and current date

attempts.thought: The error `UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode characters` occurs because the script is using box-drawing characters (like `╔`, `═`, `║`) which are not supported by the default Windows console encoding (`cp1252`). To fix this, I will replace the Unicode box-drawing characters with standard ASCII characters (`+`, `-`, `|`) that are compatible with all terminal environments.
